description: 25-prompt family trip planning eval dataset for SproutRoute AI across 7 travel planning categories. Structured context_blocks with family_profile_id references to datasets/sproutroute-profiles.json.

prompts.prompt: Plan a 3-day trip to San Diego for this family. Include one kid-friendly activity per morning and afternoon, plus restaurant recommendations for each meal.

context_blocks.trip_request: Destination: San Diego, CA. Dates: April 18-20, 2026. Duration: 3 days.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Sunny, highs 72-75F, lows 58-60F, no rain expected.
context_blocks.preferences: Kids love animals and the beach. No seafood allergies. Budget: moderate.

prompts.prompt: Create a weekend itinerary in Nashville, TN. We want a mix of outdoor and indoor activities in case of rain.

context_blocks.trip_request: Destination: Nashville, TN. Dates: May 10-11, 2026. Duration: 2 days.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Partly cloudy, highs 78-80F, 40% chance of afternoon showers Saturday.
context_blocks.preferences: Child loves music and animals. Parents enjoy live music. Budget: moderate to high.

prompts.prompt: Build a 5-day family vacation itinerary for Orlando. The toddler needs a nap from 1-3 PM daily. Include drive times between activities and suggest backup indoor options for each day.

context_blocks.trip_request: Destination: Orlando, FL. Dates: June 15-19, 2026. Duration: 5 days.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Hot and humid, highs 90-93F, daily afternoon thunderstorms likely 3-5 PM.
context_blocks.preferences: Mix of theme parks and non-park days. Toddler nap 1-3 PM is non-negotiable. Budget: high.

prompts.prompt: Plan a 4-day road trip from Chicago, IL to Mackinac Island, MI (approx 5-hour drive). Include recommended stop points every 2 hours, kid-friendly roadside attractions, and overnight hotel suggestions in each city.

context_blocks.trip_request: Route: Chicago, IL to Mackinac Island, MI. Dates: July 4-7, 2026. Duration: 4 days.
context_blocks.family_profile: Family of 4 (2 parents, kids ages 3 and 7). 3yo forward-facing harness, 7yo booster seat.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Warm, highs 82-86F, scattered storms possible July 5.
context_blocks.preferences: Kids get restless after 90 minutes in the car. Need frequent stops. Interested in nature and history.

prompts.prompt: Design a 7-day multi-destination trip covering Washington DC, Philadelphia, and New York City. One child has ADHD and needs high-stimulation activities with minimal wait times. Include a daily energy budget rating (low/medium/high) and identify quiet wind-down activities for evenings.

context_blocks.trip_request: Destinations: Washington DC, Philadelphia, NYC. Dates: March 28 - April 3, 2026. Duration: 7 days.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Spring weather, highs 55-65F, rain likely March 30 and April 1.
context_blocks.preferences: 10-year-old has ADHD, needs engaging activities. 6-year-old tires easily. Parents want at least one adults-only dinner. Budget: high.

prompts.prompt: Create a 5-day itinerary for Savannah, GA. The family is visiting grandparents who have limited mobility (wheelchair accessible venues only). Plan activities that work for ages 1 through 75, and include estimated costs for each day.

context_blocks.trip_request: Destination: Savannah, GA. Dates: October 10-14, 2026. Duration: 5 days.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Pleasant fall weather, highs 76-80F, low humidity, no rain expected.
context_blocks.preferences: Grandfather uses wheelchair. Grandmother walks slowly. Baby needs stroller-friendly paths. Budget: moderate. Interested in history and nature.

prompts.prompt: Generate a packing checklist for a family of 3 (2 parents, 3yo) going to a beach resort in Myrtle Beach, SC for 5 days. Organize by person and category (clothing, toiletries, gear, entertainment).

context_blocks.trip_request: Destination: Myrtle Beach, SC (beach resort). Dates: 5 days in late July 2026.
context_blocks.family_profile: Family of 3 (2 parents, 1 toddler age 3, potty training).
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Hot and sunny, highs 88-92F, humid, UV index 9-10.
context_blocks.preferences: Toddler is potty training. Family plans to spend most time at beach and pool.

prompts.prompt: Create a packing list for a family flying to Denver for a ski trip. We only have carry-on luggage (one bag per person). Prioritize essentials and suggest what to buy at the destination instead of packing.

context_blocks.trip_request: Destination: Denver, CO (ski trip). Dates: February 14-18, 2026.
context_blocks.family_profile: Family of 4 (2 parents, kids ages 5 and 8).
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Cold, highs 28-35F, snow expected Feb 15-16.
context_blocks.preferences: Carry-on only. Will rent ski gear at resort. Kids have never skied before. One child gets cold easily.

prompts.prompt: Build a comprehensive packing list for a family traveling to Portland, OR with an 8-month-old baby. Include a separate 'diaper bag essentials' section for the plane and a 'do not forget' priority list of the top 10 most critical items.

context_blocks.trip_request: Destination: Portland, OR. Dates: 4-day trip in September 2026.
context_blocks.family_profile: Family of 3 (2 parents, 8-month-old). Baby is formula-fed, starting solids.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Mild, highs 70-75F, light rain possible on day 3.
context_blocks.preferences: First flight with baby. Parents are anxious flyers.

prompts.prompt: Create a packing list for this family going on a 10-day trip covering 3 days in Seattle, 4 days in Maui, and 3 days in San Francisco. Account for multiple climates, laundry access mid-trip, and the 6yo's sensory sensitivities.

context_blocks.trip_request: Multi-stop: Seattle (3d), Maui (4d), San Francisco (3d). Dates: August 1-10, 2026.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Seattle: rain likely, 55F. Maui: hot and sunny, 85F. San Francisco: foggy mornings, 62F.
context_blocks.preferences: 6-year-old has sensory processing issues: only soft tagless cotton, no sandals, needs noise-canceling headphones. Laundry available at Maui hotel only.

prompts.prompt: What car seat does my 3-year-old need when we rent a car in Florida? Include the state law requirements and whether I should bring our own or rent one.

context_blocks.trip_request: Destination: Orlando, FL. Dates: April 2026.
context_blocks.family_profile: Family of 3 (2 parents, 3yo: 36in tall, 32 lbs, convertible car seat at home).
context_blocks.regulatory_context: Florida requires children under 6 to use a federally approved child restraint system; children 4-5 may use a seat belt if the car seat is not an option per statute. Forward-facing with harness recommended for 3yo at this height/weight.
context_blocks.preferences: Flying into Orlando. Renting a car.

prompts.prompt: We are driving through Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, and Georgia with kids ages 2 and 5 (DC to Atlanta road trip). Summarize the car seat laws for each state we will pass through and flag any differences we need to prepare for.

context_blocks.trip_request: Route: DC → Atlanta, passing through VA, NC, SC, GA. Dates: May 2026.
context_blocks.family_profile: Family of 4 (2 parents, 2yo rear-facing convertible, 5yo in booster).
context_blocks.regulatory_context: VA: rear-facing until age 2 or until outgrowing seat limits; booster through age 7. NC: child restraint until age 8 OR 80 lbs. SC: rear-facing until age 2; booster through age 8 OR 57in. GA: child restraint until age 8 unless 57in.
context_blocks.preferences: Both children are average height/weight for age.

prompts.prompt: Provide a family travel safety briefing for Cancun, Mexico (Hotel Zone) with kids ages 4 and 7. Include: nearest hospitals to our hotel area, common tourist scams to watch for, water safety tips, and an emergency contact card template we can print.

context_blocks.trip_request: Destination: Cancun, Mexico (Hotel Zone). Dates: December 20-27, 2026.
context_blocks.family_profile: Family of 4 (2 parents, kids 4 and 7). First international trip with kids. Strong swimmers but never in ocean waves. Parents speak basic Spanish.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Warm, highs 82-85F, occasional brief rain showers.
context_blocks.regulatory_context: Mexico emergency number: 911. Hospiten Cancun is the main international hospital in Hotel Zone. US Consular Agency Cancun: +52 998 883 0272.

prompts.prompt: The 5yo has a severe peanut allergy (carries EpiPen Jr). Create a comprehensive safety plan for our trip to Honolulu, Hawaii including: restaurant communication cards, nearest hospitals with pediatric ER, airline allergy protocols, and a step-by-step anaphylaxis response plan for each family member.

context_blocks.trip_request: Destination: Honolulu, Hawaii (staying in Waikiki). Dates: April 5-12, 2026. Flying United from SFO.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Warm, highs 80-84F, trade winds, brief showers possible.
context_blocks.regulatory_context: Kapiolani Medical Center for Women & Children is the primary pediatric ER on Oahu. United allergy policy: request allergy buffer zone 48h before flight; no guaranteed nut-free environment.

prompts.prompt: The forecast for our trip to Gatlinburg, TN shows mixed conditions. What should we adjust in our outdoor plans, and what indoor backup activities do you recommend for the family?

context_blocks.trip_request: Destination: Gatlinburg, TN. Dates: March 14-16, 2026.
context_blocks.family_profile: Family of 4 (2 parents, kids 3 and 6). Kids enjoy crafts and aquariums.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Day 1: sunny 62F. Day 2: heavy rain all day, high 48F, flash flood watch. Day 3: clearing, 58F with morning fog.
context_blocks.preferences: Planned hiking on Day 2 in Great Smoky Mountains.

prompts.prompt: We are visiting Phoenix, AZ during extreme heat with a Grand Canyon day trip planned. Redesign our day-by-day itinerary to avoid heat-related illness for kids ages 2, 6, and 9. Include hydration reminders, shade strategy, and optimal timing for outdoor activities.

context_blocks.trip_request: Destinations: Phoenix, AZ (+ Grand Canyon day trip). Dates: July 22-25, 2026.
context_blocks.family_profile: Family of 5 (2 parents, kids 2, 6, 9). Toddler overheats easily. Family from Seattle, not acclimated to desert heat.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Extreme heat: highs 110-115F in Phoenix, 95-100F at Grand Canyon South Rim. UV index 11. No rain.
context_blocks.preferences: Grand Canyon day trip on Day 2 is non-negotiable.

prompts.prompt: Our 7-day cruise departing from Miami on November 8, 2026 has the following port-of-call forecasts. For each port day, recommend whether to book the outdoor excursion or switch to an indoor alternative, considering we have kids ages 5 and 10 and one child gets severe motion sickness in rough seas.

context_blocks.trip_request: Royal Caribbean Western Caribbean cruise. Dates: November 8-14, 2026. Origin: Miami, FL.
context_blocks.family_profile: Family of 4 (2 parents, kids 5 and 10). 10yo has severe motion sickness.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Day 1 Miami: sunny 82F. Day 3 Cozumel: partly cloudy 84F, calm seas. Day 4 Grand Cayman: tropical storm warning, heavy rain, 6-8ft swells. Day 5 Jamaica: clearing, 80F, residual 4ft swells. Day 7 Miami return: sunny.
context_blocks.preferences: Planned: snorkeling Cozumel, beach day Grand Cayman, waterfall hike Jamaica. Parents want to maximize port time.

prompts.prompt: Find kid-friendly restaurants in Austin, TX that can accommodate our family's dietary needs. Suggest 3 options for each meal type (breakfast, lunch, dinner).

context_blocks.trip_request: Destination: Austin, TX. Dates: Weekend trip in May 2026.
context_blocks.family_profile: Family of 4 (2 parents, kids 4 and 7). One parent vegetarian. 4yo picky (plain pasta, chicken nuggets, fruit). 7yo has dairy allergy (not severe, can have baked-in dairy).
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Warm, highs 88F.
context_blocks.preferences: Looking for places with outdoor seating and a relaxed vibe.

prompts.prompt: We are visiting Yellowstone National Park area (staying in West Yellowstone, MT). One child is gluten-free (celiac disease) and the other is going through a phase where they only eat 5 foods. Create a meal plan for each day that keeps both kids fed and happy, including grocery store recommendations for snack stocking.

context_blocks.trip_request: Destination: Yellowstone NP (West Yellowstone, MT base). Dates: August 3-7, 2026.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Sunny, highs 75-80F, cool evenings around 45F.
context_blocks.preferences: Limited restaurant options near park. Have a cooler in the car.

prompts.prompt: Plan all meals for a 6-day trip to Los Angeles (staying in Santa Monica). Dietary constraints: kosher family (no mixing meat and dairy, only kosher-certified meat), one child has a tree nut allergy, and the baby is transitioning to solids. Include both restaurant and self-catering options.

context_blocks.trip_request: Destination: Los Angeles, CA (Santa Monica). Dates: June 1-6, 2026.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Sunny, highs 75-78F, coastal fog mornings.
context_blocks.preferences: Strictly kosher (separate meat and dairy, kosher-certified restaurants preferred). Vacation rental has a full kitchen.

prompts.prompt: Plan a 2-day visit to Walt Disney World Magic Kingdom in Orlando. List which rides are appropriate for each child by height, suggest the best time to arrive, and include a break/nap strategy.

context_blocks.trip_request: Destination: Walt Disney World Magic Kingdom. Dates: September 18-19, 2026 (weekdays).
context_blocks.family_profile: Family of 4 (2 parents, 3yo at 38in tall, 7yo at 50in tall). 3yo first theme park. 7yo loves coasters.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Hot, highs 89F, afternoon thunderstorms likely 2-4 PM.
context_blocks.preferences: Using stroller for the toddler. Have Genie+ but not Individual Lightning Lane.

prompts.prompt: Create an optimized touring plan for Universal Studios and Islands of Adventure in Orlando (2 parks, 2 days). One parent will stay with the toddler during thrill rides while the other takes the older kids. Include a rider switch strategy and show/parade schedule integration.

context_blocks.trip_request: Destination: Universal Orlando (USF + IOA). Dates: October 8-9, 2026.
context_blocks.family_profile: Family of 5 (2 parents, kids 2, 6, 11). 11yo huge Harry Potter fan. 6yo scared of dark rides. 2yo in stroller.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Sunny, highs 84F, low chance of rain.
context_blocks.preferences: Have Express Unlimited passes. Want to minimize walking distance.

prompts.prompt: We have 1 day at Disneyland Resort (Disneyland + California Adventure). The 5yo uses a wheelchair. Create a minute-by-minute touring plan that maximizes ride count while using DAS (Disability Access Service), includes character meal reservations, and has a contingency plan for ride breakdowns.

context_blocks.trip_request: Destination: Disneyland Resort, Anaheim, CA. Dates: Saturday, November 14, 2026. Park hopper tickets.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Sunny, highs 72F, clear all day.
context_blocks.preferences: Only 1 day — must be efficient. 5-year-old qualifies for DAS. 9-year-old wants to ride every roller coaster. Want princess character dining. Arriving at rope drop, staying until close.

prompts.prompt: We are traveling from the US to Tokyo, Japan. Create a preparation checklist covering: passport/visa requirements for minors, recommended vaccinations, time zone adjustment strategy for the kids, currency tips, essential phrases to teach the children, and a cultural etiquette briefing for the family.

context_blocks.trip_request: Destination: Tokyo, Japan. Dates: December 20-30, 2026. Duration: 10 days. Flying from LAX (17h time shift).
context_blocks.weather_forecast: Cold, highs 45-50F, dry. Possible snow late December.
context_blocks.regulatory_context: US citizens need passport valid 6+ months beyond stay. Japan visa-free for tourism up to 90 days. No mandatory vaccines. Child passport valid 5 years.
context_blocks.preferences: First international trip for the kids.

prompts.prompt: Plan a 14-day multi-country European trip covering London (4d), Paris (4d), Barcelona (3d), Rome (3d). Include: border crossing logistics, car seat regulations in each country, health insurance considerations, SIM card/connectivity plan, kid-friendly transit strategies, and a realistic daily budget breakdown in local currencies.

context_blocks.trip_request: Route: London → Paris → Barcelona → Rome. Dates: July 1-14, 2026.
context_blocks.family_profile: Family of 5 (2 parents, kids 1, 5, 10). Baby in carrier/stroller. 5yo walks but tires after 30 min. 10yo interested in history. One parent speaks French, no other languages.
context_blocks.weather_forecast: London: 65-72F rainy. Paris: 72-80F sunny. Barcelona: 82-88F sunny. Rome: 85-92F hot and sunny.
context_blocks.regulatory_context: UK car seat law: child restraint until 12yo or 135cm. France: until 10yo or 135cm. Spain: until 135cm. Italy: until 150cm. UK uses left-hand traffic. Schengen: Paris, Barcelona, Rome share border-free travel; UK separate post-Brexit.
context_blocks.preferences: Traveling by train between cities (Eurostar + TGV + high-speed rail). Budget: moderate.
